name: @example/run-timeline
title: Run Timeline
description: Plugin tile of the dashboards proof of concept. It shows the latest workflow run as a tree. The tile uses @wippy/dashboards-tile-helper (from the wippy/dashboards module) for the tile protocol and writes only its rendering.

wippy.description: Dashboard tile that shows the latest workflow run as a tree: the run's type, status, start time and duration, and each node with its type, status and duration. It is not used by hand: the dashboard board (dashboard-layout) creates it and sets the tile_v1 attributes (tile-id, data-sources, actions, fields, options, params, mode) and, last, request-id. Input `main` has the shape `schema` (the schema is in src/demo_run_timeline/_index.yaml). The tile reads the data itself and reports render-state to the board. Data that does not match the shape is reported as an error.

request-id.description: A new id for each configuration. The board sets it last, and the tile starts work only when it is set.

data-sources.description: Map from input name to { url, args, refresh_ms, live_topic }. run-timeline reads the input main.

actions.description: Map from action name to { url, confirm }. run-timeline has no actions.

fields.description: Map from the tile field names to data field names. run-timeline has none.

params.description: Current values of the page parameters the tile declares.

mode.description: view (the POC has no edit mode).
